families.label: Direct jailbreak
families.detail: Role play, authority claims, policy overrides, and encoded requests target the model-facing instruction boundary.

families.label: Obfuscation and mutation
families.detail: Unicode, token splitting, paraphrase, translation, and context padding preserve intent while changing surface form.

families.label: Indirect prompt injection
families.detail: Untrusted retrieved pages, documents, or tool results attempt to become higher-priority instructions.

families.label: Multi-turn escalation
families.detail: A benign opening accumulates context, trust, or partial answers before crossing a policy boundary.

families.label: Tool and privilege misuse
families.detail: The model attempts unauthorized reads, writes, purchases, messages, or permission changes through connected tools.

families.label: Privacy exfiltration
families.detail: Attackers probe for system prompts, secrets, memorized data, cross-tenant context, and retrieval authorization gaps.

surfaces.label: Public chat assistant
surfaces.detail: No retrieval or tools, but public users can adapt prompts across sessions.

surfaces.label: RAG assistant
surfaces.detail: Retrieved content creates an untrusted instruction channel and a data-authorization boundary.

surfaces.label: Tool-using agent
surfaces.detail: Retrieval, memory, and side-effecting tools add privilege and cumulative-action risks.

campaigns.label: Template replay
campaigns.detail: Replay known prompt strings quickly, with little mutation or adaptive search.

campaigns.label: Taxonomy grid
campaigns.detail: Cross risk categories with attack mutations and system surfaces, but without adaptive search.

campaigns.label: Adaptive campaign
campaigns.detail: Use prior outputs to mutate attacks, chain turns, and investigate promising failures with expert review.
